We replicate the analysis of arXiv:1706.03762 (the original Transformer paper)
and contrast it with the earlier sequence-to-sequence work
arXiv:1409.3215. The licensing terms follow doi:10.1145/3460120.3484797
where applicable.

For background on the IT-systems side, the curl-team disclosure described in
github.com/curl/curl/issues/12604 is illustrative.
